title: A robust method to identify chimera states
summary: Chimera states are one of the most intriguing phenomena in nonlinear dynamics, characterized by the coexistence of coherent and incoherent behavior in systems of coupled identical oscillators. Despite extensive studies and numerous observations in different settings, the development of reliable and systematic methods to classify chimera states and distinguish them from other dynamical patterns remains a challenging task.
